issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מַה יִּסְכָּן לָךְ' means 'What profit is it to you?' (i.e., what benefit does God gain from my righteousness), not '我當為你預備甚麼呢' ('What should I prepare for you?'). The verb 'יִּסְכָּן' means 'profit/gain', not 'prepare'. This changes the meaning of the verse.

The Hebrew 'מָה אֹעִיל מֵחַטָּאתִי' means 'What do I gain from my sin?' (i.e., what benefit do I get from my sin), not '從我的罪中我能獻甚麼呢' ('What can I offer from my sin?'). The verb 'אֹעִיל' means 'profit/gain', not 'offer/sacrifice'. This reverses the subject and object of the question.
